title: Wordies
description:
[I haven't had time to update this game for a while, and as a result I'm making it free]

WORDIES

 The premise of wordies is simple, you're randomly assigned the task of guessing a commonly used American word. But with only 5 tries, Wordies is harder than it 

 looks. Wordies also features a Daily Word & a global highstreak leaderboard where you can compete with not only your friends but the rest of the world to be the best!

 When guessing you're given 3 different clues in the form of colors to help you along your way!

 

Dark Gray - Indicates the letter you've chosen does not appear in the word.

 

Orange - Indicates the letter you've entered is in the word, but appears in a different place.

 

Green - Indicates the letter is in the correct place, but there is still the possibility of it appearing twice!

 

 Build up winstreaks, fustrate yourself, & challenge friends all in an hour of wordies!
description_short: Wordies is bringing a word game you've most likely played & enjoyed to Steam. But it's harder than before, with only 5 guesses you're given the not so easy task of guessing a common American word! Guess the daily word & build up highstreaks to compete against the world in our global leaderboards!
